description: Department of Forest - Notify the order declaring Elagamuwa Forest in Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District as "Elagamuwa Reserved Forest"
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a reserved forest under the Forest Conservation Ordinance, which constitutes a regulatory/legal matter. It cites specific legal authorities (amended acts) and creates a legally binding order regarding land use and conservation. While it names a Minister (Maithripala Sirisena), this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make a regulatory declaration, not to announce a personnel change or define ministerial portfolios. The core content is legal/regulatory in nature, establishing protected forest boundaries and legal status.
